title: Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion Among Cancer Patients With Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Updated Meta-Analysis.
summary: Left atrial appendage occlusion (LAAO) is a well-established therapy for atrial fibrillation in patients with contraindications to oral anticoagulation. However, the clinical outcomes of LAAO in patients with cancer remain poorly defined. Therefore, we performed an updated meta-analysis to evaluate the safety and efficacy of LAAO in patients with cancer. PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane databases were systematically searched for studies evaluating LAAO in patients with atrial fibrillation and cancer. Our end points of interest were long-term stroke, bleeding, and all-cause mortality. We reported the end points as hazard ratios (HRs), odds ratios ,and 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Additionally, a prespecified subgroup analysis comparing patients with active and history of cancer was performed. Heterogeneity was assessed using the I2 statistic. We included 9 studies with 209,325 patients, of whom 39.3% were female and had a mean age of 77 years. Cancer was significantly associated with higher long-term all-cause mortality (HR 1.64, 95% CI 1.20 to 2.23, p = 0.002). However, no significant associations were observed for long-term stroke (HR 0.59, 95% CI 0.30 to 1.15, p = 0.12) or long-term bleeding (HR 1.02, 95% CI 0.57 to 1.83, p = 0.94). No significant difference was observed between active and history of cancer subgroups (p = 0.146). In this meta-analysis, cancer was associated with higher long-term mortality in patients who underwent LAAO. Nevertheless, there was no difference between cancer and noncancer groups' risk for thromboembolic or bleeding events.

title: First experience of zero-fluoro pulsed field ablation for atrial fibrillation: step-by-step. A case report
summary: Introduction. Pulsed field ablation (PFA) is an innovative method for the treatment of atrial fibrillation (AF). The concept of zero-fluoroscopy during ablation procedures is not new. The feasibility and safety of intracardiac echocardiography (ICE)-guided radiofrequency pulmonary vein (PV) isolation have been previously described. In this case, we aim to demonstrate a method of non-fluoro PFA without the 3D navigation mapping system. Brief description . We present the first successful experience of pulmonary vein PFA using a domestic circular catheter under ICE guidance in a patient with paroxysmal AF. Transmurality in the ablation area was confirmed by subsequent 3D electroanatomical mapping. Discussion . We have identified the following key messages: (1) ICE-guided positioning of the circular catheter is feasible and safe; (2) imaging of tight catheter contact with the pulmonary vein ostia is a mandatory aspect of the PFA procedure and ensures isolation in the target area, as confirmed by electroanatomical mapping; (3) the high safety profile of the procedure, achieved through real-time imaging, may contribute to a reduction in the risk of intraoperative complications. Conclusion . ICE-guided zero-fluoro PFA represents a new step in the treatment of AF. However, further studies are needed to evaluate the safety of the zero-fluoro approach compared to conventional fluoroscopic imaging methods during PFA in patients with AF.

title: Relationship between soluble suppression of tumorigenicity 2 and arrhythmias and mortality risk in patients receiving maintenance hemodialysis
summary: Aim . To evaluate the prognostic significance of soluble suppression of tumorigenicity 2 (sST2) as a biomarker of all-cause and cardiovascular mortality risk in patients with end-stage renal disease undergoing maintenance hemodialysis, and to analyze its associations with clinical and laboratory parameters and arrhythmias. Material and methods. This prospective cohort study included 88 patients on maintenance hemodialysis (median follow-up — 64 months). At baseline, all participants underwent a general clinical examination, 48-hour Holter ECG monitoring, and measurement of sST2 levels using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. Statistical analysis included ROC analysis, Spearman correlation, and group comparisons using the Mann-Whitney U test and χ2 test. Results . During the follow-up period, 36 patients (40,9%) died, including 24 (27,3%) from cardiovascular causes. sST2 levels were significantly higher in the group of patients who died from all causes (40,0 [38,0; 44,5] ng/mL vs 30,0 [26,5; 32,0] ng/mL, p=0,000001) and from cardiovascular causes (35,0 [31,0; 41,5] ng/mL, p=0,00001). An sST2 level ≥35 ng/mL was a powerful predictor of all-cause (AUC=0,957) and cardiovascular mortality (AUC=0,992). A strong association was found between sST2 and atrial fibrillation (40,0 ng/mL vs 31,0 ng/mL, p=0,000003), as well as a positive correlation with the number of supraventricular extrasystoles recorded on the first day (r=0,404, p=0,001) in patients who died from cardiovascular causes. Conclusion. sST2 is a highly informative independent predictor of all-cause and cardiovascular mortality in patients on maintenance hemodialysis and is associated with atrial fibrillation and supraventricular ectopic activity, which justifies its inclusion in routine risk stratification for this population.

title: Prevalence, Incidence, and Impact of Cancer in Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of 70,000,000 Patients.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Contemporary studies indicate that atrial fibrillation (AF) is common in patients with cancer and adversely affects their prognosis. AF and cancer also share several risk factors. Nevertheless, the prevalence, incidence, and overall impact of cancer in patients with AF are not well defined. This study was designed to estimate the prevalence and incidence of cancer in an AF population and to evaluate its effect on clinical outcomes.

METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis were performed following international guidelines. We searched PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, and Cochrane Library for studies reporting the prevalence and incidence of cancer in patients with AF. Data were extracted from the included studies and pooled using a random-effects model.

RESULTS: The overall prevalence of cancer among AF patients was 1141.01 per 10,000 (95% CI: 975.43-1330.56; 95% PI: 219.37-4251.57), with an incidence of 172.22 per 10,000 person-years (95% CI: 127.76-232.15; 95% PI: 40.32-735.69). Both prevalence and incidence varied according to cancer type, patient gender, and comorbid conditions. Cancer was associated with a significantly increased risk of all-cause mortality (OR: 1.83, 95% CI: 1.60-2.08) and bleeding (OR: 1.62, 95% CI: 1.37-1.92). No significant associations were observed for cardiovascular death or stroke/systemic embolism.

CONCLUSIONS: Cancer is common in AF patients, affecting approximately 11% of this population. In addition, the incidence of cancer in AF patients is substantial and should not be overlooked. title: PREVENTING EXERCISE-RELATED SUDDEN CARDIAC DEATH THROUGH SYSTEMATIC PREPARTICIPATION CARDIOVASCULAR SCREENING: A TWO-YEAR REGIONAL COHORT STUDY OF PEDIATRIC ATHLETES IN ADJARA, GEORGIA.
summary:
AIM: To determine the prevalence and risk stratification profile of cardiovascular abnormalities identified during a two-year structured preparticipation screening programme among pediatric competitive athletes in Adjara, Georgia, and to evaluate its implications for prevention of exercise-related sudden cardiac death.

MATERIAL AND METHODS: A cross-sectional cohort study was conducted over two consecutive athletic seasons (2023-2025) in the Autonomous Republic of Adjara, Georgia. A total of 647 competitive athletes aged 5-17 years were enrolled through organized sports institutions. All participants underwent standardized cardiovascular evaluation comprising structured medical history, physical examination, resting 12-lead electrocardiography interpreted according to international athlete-specific criteria, and transthoracic echocardiography. Detected abnormalities were classified into low-, intermediate-, and high-risk categories for sudden cardiac death in accordance with the 2020 ESC Guidelines on Sports Cardiology and Exercise in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease. Exact 95% confidence intervals were calculated using the Wilson Score method.

RESULTS: Cardiovascular abnormalities were identified in 73 of 647 athletes (11.3%; 95% CI 9.1-14.0%). High-risk conditions requiring specialist cardiology evaluation and individualized, shared decision-making-based sports eligibility assessment were detected in 4 athletes (0.62%; 95% CI 0.24-1.57%), comprising one case of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and three cases of clinically significant conduction disorders. All four affected individuals were previously asymptomatic. The most prevalent abnormalities were patent foramen ovale (4.02%), mitral valve disease (3.09%), and mitral valve insufficiency (1.85%). The number needed to screen to identify one high-risk condition was 162 athletes.

CONCLUSIONS: Structured preparticipation cardiovascular screening in pediatric athletes in Adjara identifies a clinically meaningful burden of previously undetected cardiac pathology, including life-threatening conditions in asymptomatic individuals. The timely detection of high-risk conditions facilitated specialist referral and entry into an individualized, shared decision-making-based sports eligibility process, thereby potentially preventing exercise-related sudden cardiac events in this cohort. These findings provide essential region-specific epidemiological parameters and support the systematic integration of ECG-inclusive cardiovascular screening, aligned with the 2025 AHA/ACC shared decision-making framework, within organized youth sports programmes in Georgia.

title: Predictive value of pre-procedural QTc interval for in-hospital major adverse cardiovascular events following primary percutaneous coronary intervention in acute myocardial infarction.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The relationship between pre-procedural corrected QT (QTc) interval and in-hospital major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) following primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) remains incompletely understood. This study evaluated the predictive value of pre-procedural QTc for in-hospital MACE.

METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort study consecutively enrolled AMI patients undergoing primary PCI. QTc intervals were manually measured from pre-procedural 12-lead electrocardiograms using the Bazett formula, with a prespecified sensitivity analysis using the Fridericia formula. Missing data sensitivity analyses (complete-case BNP model and multiple imputation, m = 20) confirmed that BNP adjustment did not alter the QTc effect. No formal sample size calculation was performed; findings are exploratory. The primary endpoint was in-hospital MACE (composite of ventricular arrhythmias, cardiogenic shock, acute heart failure, and bleeding complications). Logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses were performed.Among 123 patients (mean age 55.3 ± 11.9 years; 91.1% male), 53 (43.1%) experienced MACE. Prolonged QTc (>440 ms) was associated with MACE in univariate analysis (OR = 3.01, 95% CI: 1.41-6.39, P = 0.004). After multivariate adjustment, reduced LVEF (OR = 0.76 per 5%, P = 0.019) and elevated baseline heart rate (OR = 1.57 per 10 bpm, P = 0.023) were independent predictors; continuous QTc was not (OR = 1.03 per 10 ms, P = 0.605). The model AUC was 0.767 (optimism-corrected AUC = 0.782; optimism = -0.014). Adding QTc to conventional risk factors yielded negligible incremental AUC (Δ = 0.001, P = 0.888). A numerically high MACE rate was observed in the small subgroup with both LVEF <40% and QTc >440 ms (9/11, 81.8%; 95% CI: 48.2%-97.7%), but the LVEF-QTc interaction was not statistically significant (P = 0.941), precluding any conclusion of synergistic risk. A prespecified sensitivity analysis excluding isolated bleeding events (cardiovascular MACE = 40/123, 32.5%) confirmed that LVEF remained independently predictive (OR = 0.73, P = 0.008) while QTc showed no independent association (P = 0.915) and no incremental value (ΔAUC = 0.000, P = 0.772). A further sensitivity analysis using the Fridericia formula abolished the univariate QTc-MACE association (OR = 1.23, P = 0.615 vs. OR = 3.01, P = 0.004 with Bazett), indicating that Bazett overcorrection at high heart rates contributed substantially to the apparent univariate signal. BNP adjustment (complete-case and multiple imputation) did not change the QTc coefficient (>1% variation), indicating no residual BNP confounding.

CONCLUSIONS: Pre-procedural QTc prolongation is associated with in-hospital MACE but is not an independent predictor after adjustment for conventional risk factors, with limited incremental value (ΔAUC = 0.001). A numerically high MACE rate was noted among patients with both reduced LVEF and prolonged QTc, but this observation derives from only 11 patients with a nonsignificant interaction term (P = 0.941); it should be regarded as exploratory and requires validation in larger prospective studies.

title: The coronary sinus: A clinical perspective for the electrophysiologist.
summary: The coronary sinus (CS) is a specialized cardiac structure whose embryologic and anatomic features may contribute to arrhythmogenesis. Composed of both venous and myocardial elements, it can be conceptualized as a distinct cardiac chamber with connections to both the left and right atria-characteristics that make it an important site for the initiation and maintenance of atrial arrhythmias, as well as a key structure in explaining the underlying physiology of atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT) and the origin of epicardial bypass tracts. The vein, ligament, and myocardial bundle of Marshall arise from the proximal CS and maintain electrical connections with the left atrium and the left-sided pulmonary veins. Because of their electrophysiological and autonomic properties, these structures may contribute to both atrial and ventricular arrhythmias. Furthermore, the proximity of CS tributaries to the ventricular myocardium provides access for the mapping and ablation of selected ventricular arrhythmias, complementing the established role of these vessels in left ventricular pacing.

AI.conclusion: 冠状窦是电生理医生需重视的多功能结构，既参与房性心律失常与AVNRT机制，也为心外膜旁路及部分室性心律失常的标测消融和左室起搏提供通路；但本文为叙述性综述，缺乏原始数据，相关临床价值仍需研究验证。

summary_zh: 冠状窦（coronary sinus, CS）是一种特殊的心脏结构，其胚胎学和解剖学特征可能促进心律失常的发生。它由静脉和心肌成分共同构成，可被视为一个独立的心脏腔室，与左心房和右心房均有连接——这些特征使其成为房性心律失常起始和维持的重要部位，也是解释房室结折返性心动过速（atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia, AVNRT）潜在生理机制及心外膜旁路起源的关键结构。Marshall静脉、韧带和心肌束起自冠状窦近端，并与左心房及左侧肺静脉保持电连接。由于其电生理和自主神经特性，这些结构可能参与房性和室性心律失常的发生。此外，冠状窦属支与心室心肌邻近，为选择性室性心律失常的标测和消融提供了通路，补充了这些血管在左心室起搏中的既定作用。

title: Advances in left bundle branch area pacing: current evidence, clinical applications, and future perspectives.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) resynchronizes the left ventricle through the conduction system rather than through a coronary sinus lead, and is increasingly used as an alternative to biventricular pacing (BVP) for cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.

AREAS COVERED: Drawing on a search of PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Library and ClinicalTrials.gov from January 2015 through September 2026, this review covers the anatomical basis of LBBAP, implantation and confirmation of capture, complications, observational and randomized comparisons with BVP, guideline and consensus positions, and emerging technologies from ultra-high-frequency electrocardiography to leadless pacing.

EXPERT OPINION: Registries and meta-analyses favor LBBAP, but six randomized trials point in different directions, from inferiority to a large reduction in death or heart failure hospitalization over three years. Where capture type was reported, outcome followed confirmed conduction system capture more closely than randomized allocation, a pattern that is consistent but unproven. Until trials with hard endpoints report capture type, we would place LBBAP first in centers able to document conduction system capture in most of their patients, and keep BVP as the default elsewhere.

AI.tldr: 左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）在观察性研究和荟萃分析中优于双心室起搏（BVP），但六项随机试验结果不一，从劣效到大幅降低死亡或心衰住院不等；结局与确认的传导系统夺获更相关，但尚未证实。
AI.motivation: LBBAP通过传导系统而非冠状静脉窦导线实现左室再同步，正逐渐成为射血分数降低的心衰患者心脏再同步治疗（CRT）中BVP的替代方案。然而，随机试验证据方向不一致，且夺获类型对结局的影响尚不明确，临床决策缺乏硬终点随机证据。
AI.method: 这是一篇综述，检索PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library和ClinicalTrials.gov（2015年1月至2026年9月），涵盖LBBAP的解剖基础、植入与夺获确认、并发症、与BVP的观察性和随机比较、指南与共识立场，以及超高频心电图和无导线起搏等新兴技术。摘要未报告系统评价的样本量、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 注册研究和荟萃分析倾向于支持LBBAP，但六项随机试验结果方向不一，从劣效到三年内死亡或心衰住院大幅降低不等。在报告夺获类型的研究中，结局与确认的传导系统夺获的相关性比随机分组更密切，该模式一致但未经证实。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 在能够记录大多数患者传导系统夺获的中心，可将LBBAP作为首选；在其他中心，BVP仍为默认选择。需等待报告夺获类型的硬终点随机试验结果，以明确LBBAP在CRT中的地位。

summary_zh:
引言：左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）通过传导系统而非冠状窦导线实现左心室再同步化，正日益被用作双心室起搏（BVP）的替代方案，用于射血分数降低的心力衰竭患者的心脏再同步治疗（CRT）。

涵盖领域：本综述基于对PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library和ClinicalTrials.gov从2015年1月至2026年9月的检索，涵盖LBBAP的解剖学基础、植入与夺获确认、并发症、与BVP的观察性和随机比较、指南与共识立场，以及从超高频心电图到无导线起搏的新兴技术。

专家意见：注册研究和荟萃分析倾向于支持LBBAP，但六项随机试验指向不同方向，从劣效到三年内死亡或心力衰竭住院的大幅减少不等。在报告了夺获类型的试验中，结局与确认的传导系统夺获的相关性比随机分组更密切，这一模式一致但尚未被证实。在具有硬终点的试验报告夺获类型之前，我们会在能够记录大多数患者传导系统夺获的中心将LBBAP列为首选，而在其他中心则保留BVP作为默认选择。

title: Cardiac Resynchronization as an Enabler of ARNI Efficacy: Insights From a Real-World Cohort.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Sacubitril/valsartan (ARNI) improves outcomes in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). In patients undergoing cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT), the potential synergy between device-based and pharmacological strategies remains underexplored.

METHODS: The aim of this study was to assess the effect of ARNI therapy on reverse remodeling, clinical response, and cardiovascular events at 1 year in CRT recipients, in order to clarify the potential synergistic role of pharmacological and device-based strategies. A retrospective cohort of 194 consecutive CRT patients was analyzed, of whom 65 (33.5%) received ARNI. Echocardiographic response was defined as an increase in LVEF > 5% or ≥ 15% reduction in LV end-systolic volume at 12 months; clinical response as an improvement of at least one NYHA class. The primary endpoint was echocardiographic response. Device-detected remote monitoring heart failure (RM-HF) events were pre-specified as the key time-to-event endpoint, while mortality and HF hospitalization were exploratory.

RESULTS: Baseline characteristics were comparable, although systolic blood pressure was higher in ARNI recipients. At 12 months, ARNI therapy was associated with greater reverse remodeling (ΔLVEF 14.4% ± 10.2% vs. 10.8% ± 11.0%, p = 0.04). Rates of echocardiographic (68% vs. 67%) and clinical response (68% vs. 74%) were similar. Mortality and HF hospitalization did not differ significantly. In contrast, ARNI recipients showed fewer RM-HF events, with higher event-free survival among echocardiographic responders (95.7% vs. 82.6%; log-rank p = 0.021, q = 0.042) and clinical responders (93.4% vs. 85.3%; p = 0.040, q = 0.040).

CONCLUSIONS: In this real-world CRT cohort, ARNI therapy enhanced reverse remodeling and reduced subclinical congestion events detected by remote monitoring. These findings support a synergistic interaction between CRT and ARNI, where resynchronization provides the substrate for pharmacological efficacy.

AI.tldr: 在真实世界CRT队列中，联合ARNI治疗可增强左室逆重构并减少远程监测发现的心衰事件，提示器械与药物存在协同作用。
AI.motivation: ARNI可改善HFrEF患者预后，但CRT患者中器械治疗与药物治疗的潜在协同作用尚不明确，本研究旨在评估ARNI对CRT术后逆重构、临床反应及心血管事件的影响。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入194例连续CRT患者，65例（33.5%）接受ARNI。主要终点为12个月超声心动图反应（LVEF增加>5%或LVESV降低≥15%）；临床反应定义为NYHA心功能分级改善至少1级；关键时间-事件终点为器械远程监测心衰（RM-HF）事件，死亡和心衰住院为探索性终点。
AI.result: 12个月时，ARNI组逆重构更显著（ΔLVEF 14.4%±10.2% vs. 10.8%±11.0%，p=0.04）。超声心动图反应率（68% vs. 67%）和临床反应率（68% vs. 74%）相似。死亡和心衰住院无显著差异。ARNI组RM-HF事件更少，在超声心动图反应者中无事件生存率更高（95.7% vs. 82.6%；log-rank p=0.021，q=0.042），临床反应者中亦更高（93.4% vs. 85.3%；p=0.040，q=0.040）。
AI.conclusion: 在真实世界CRT队列中，ARNI增强逆重构并减少远程监测发现的亚临床淤血事件，支持CRT与ARNI的协同作用，即再同步化治疗为药物疗效提供基础。需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：沙库巴曲/缬沙坦（ARNI）可改善射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）患者的预后。在接受心脏再同步治疗（CRT）的患者中，器械治疗与药物治疗策略之间的潜在协同作用仍未得到充分探索。

方法：本研究旨在评估ARNI治疗对CRT接受者1年时逆向重构、临床反应和心血管事件的影响，以阐明药物与器械策略的潜在协同作用。分析了一个由194例连续CRT患者组成的回顾性队列，其中65例（33.5%）接受了ARNI。超声心动图反应定义为12个月时LVEF增加> 5%或左室收缩末期容积减少≥ 15%；临床反应定义为NYHA分级至少改善一个级别。主要终点为超声心动图反应。器械检测的远程监测心力衰竭（RM-HF）事件被预先指定为关键的时间-事件终点，而死亡和HF住院为探索性终点。

结果：基线特征具有可比性，尽管ARNI接受者的收缩压更高。在12个月时，ARNI治疗与更大的逆向重构相关（ΔLVEF 14.4% ± 10.2% vs. 10.8% ± 11.0%，p = 0.04）。超声心动图反应率（68% vs. 67%）和临床反应率（68% vs. 74%）相似。死亡率和HF住院无显著差异。相比之下，ARNI接受者的RM-HF事件更少，在超声心动图反应者中无事件生存率更高（95.7% vs. 82.6%；log-rank p = 0.021，q = 0.042），在临床反应者中亦然（93.4% vs. 85.3%；p = 0.040，q = 0.040）。

结论：在这个真实世界的CRT队列中，ARNI治疗增强了逆向重构并减少了远程监测检测到的亚临床淤血事件。这些发现支持CRT与ARNI之间的协同相互作用，其中再同步化提供了药物疗效的基础。

title: Functional Mitral Regurgitation Trajectories in CRT-Treated HFrEF During Medical Therapy Optimization: Association with Reverse Remodeling
summary: Background: Functional mitral regurgitation (MR) is common in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) and may persist despite cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT). Sacubitril/valsartan is associated with reverse remodeling in HFrEF, but MR dynamics in CRT-treated patients receiving sacubitril/valsartan remain insufficiently characterized. We aimed to characterize longitudinal changes in MR severity and assess their association with ventricular reverse remodeling in CRT-treated patients with HFrEF receiving sacubitril/valsartan. Methods: This retrospective cohort study included 188 patients with HFrEF previously treated with CRT who subsequently initiated sacubitril/valsartan. Clinical and echocardiographic assessments were performed at baseline and 10-14 months. The primary endpoint was MR improvement, defined a priori as a reduction of at least one MR grade. Changes in paired MR grade distribution were assessed using Bowker's test of symmetry. Associations between MR improvement and changes in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF), left ventricular end-diastolic volume (LVEDV), and left atrial volume (LAV) were evaluated. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors independently associated with MR improvement. Results: MR improvement occurred in 116 patients (62%), while 72 (38%) had unchanged grades; no worsening was documented in the paired assessments. A significant shift toward lower MR grades was observed between baseline and follow-up (χ2 = 116.0, df = 5, p < 0.001). The proportion meeting the endpoint increased from 0% in baseline grade I to 51.2%, 80.0%, and 100% in grades II, III, and IV, respectively. Patients with MR improvement had greater increases in LVEF (9.0 vs. 7.0 percentage points, p = 0.006) and larger reductions in LVEDV (-45.7 vs. -28.6 mL, p = 0.004) and LAV (-20.4 vs. -4.2 mL, p < 0.001). The correlation between changes in LVEDV and MR grade was statistically significant but modest (r = 0.22, p = 0.002). Non-ischemic etiology and greater baseline LVEDV were independently associated with MR improvement, whereas baseline LVEF was not. The strong association with baseline MR grade partly reflects the endpoint's inherent dependence on initial severity. Conclusions: In patients with HFrEF treated with CRT who also received sacubitril/valsartan, lower MR grades were observed at follow-up and were associated with greater longitudinal changes in LVEF, LVEDV, and LAV. These findings describe parallel longitudinal changes in MR severity and cardiac structure within a combined device- and pharmacological-treatment setting. The observed changes cannot be disentangled from ongoing CRT-mediated remodeling, concomitant GDMT, changes in loading conditions, or other time-dependent factors and cannot be attributed specifically to sacubitril/valsartan.

AI.tldr: 在接受CRT的HFrEF患者中，加用沙库巴曲/缬沙坦后62%出现功能性二尖瓣反流改善，且与左室逆重构（LVEF提升、LVEDV和LAV缩小）相关。
AI.motivation: 功能性二尖瓣反流在HFrEF中常见，部分患者CRT后仍持续存在；沙库巴曲/缬沙坦可促进逆重构，但CRT治疗患者中该药对二尖瓣反流动态变化的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，纳入188例既往接受CRT并随后启用沙库巴曲/缬沙坦的HFrEF患者，基线和10-14个月行临床和超声评估。主要终点为二尖瓣反流改善（较基线降低至少一个反流级别）。采用Bowker对称性检验分析配对反流级别分布变化，评估反流改善与LVEF、LVEDV、LAV变化的相关性，并用多因素logistic回归识别独立相关因素。
AI.result: 116例（62%）二尖瓣反流改善，72例（38%）级别不变，无恶化。随访期间反流级别显著向更低级别偏移（χ2=116.0，df=5，p<0.001）。达到终点的比例从基线I级的0%增至II、III、IV级的51.2%、80.0%和100%。反流改善组LVEF提升更大（9.0 vs. 7.0个百分点，p=0.006），LVEDV（-45.7 vs. -28.6 mL，p=0.004）和LAV（-20.4 vs. -4.2 mL，p<0.001）降幅更大。LVEDV变化与反流级别的相关性弱但显著（r=0.22，p=0.002）。非缺血性病因和较大基线LVEDV与反流改善独立相关，基线LVEF则否。
AI.conclusion: 在CRT治疗的HFrEF患者中加用沙库巴曲/缬沙坦后，随访时二尖瓣反流级别降低，并与LVEF、LVEDV和LAV的纵向改善相关。但这些变化无法与CRT介导的逆重构、指南导向药物治疗、负荷条件改变等因素区分，不能归因于沙库巴曲/缬沙坦本身；研究为回顾性设计，结论需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 背景：功能性二尖瓣反流（MR）在射血分数降低的心力衰竭（HFrEF）患者中常见，并且尽管接受了心脏再同步治疗（CRT），仍可能持续存在。沙库巴曲/缬沙坦与HFrEF中的逆向重构相关，但在接受沙库巴曲/缬沙坦治疗的CRT患者中，MR的动态变化尚未得到充分描述。我们旨在描述接受沙库巴曲/缬沙坦治疗的CRT-HFrEF患者中MR严重程度的纵向变化，并评估其与心室逆向重构的关联。方法：这项回顾性队列研究纳入了188例既往接受CRT治疗、随后开始使用沙库巴曲/缬沙坦的HFrEF患者。在基线和10-14个月时进行临床和超声心动图评估。主要终点是MR改善，预先定义为MR分级至少降低一个等级。配对MR分级分布的变化使用Bowker对称性检验进行评估。评估MR改善与左心室射血分数（LVEF）、左心室舒张末期容积（LVEDV）和左心房容积（LAV）变化之间的关联。使用多变量逻辑回归识别与MR改善独立相关的因素。结果：116例患者（62%）出现MR改善，而72例（38%）分级不变；配对评估中未记录到恶化。在基线和随访之间观察到向较低MR分级的显著转变（χ2 = 116.0，df = 5，p < 0.001）。达到终点的比例从基线I级的0%分别增加到II级、III级和IV级的51.2%、80.0%和100%。MR改善的患者LVEF增加更大（9.0 vs. 7.0个百分点，p = 0.006），LVEDV降低更多（-45.7 vs. -28.6 mL，p = 0.004），LAV降低更多（-20.4 vs. -4.2 mL，p < 0.001）。LVEDV变化与MR分级变化之间的相关性具有统计学显著性但较弱（r = 0.22，p = 0.002）。非缺血性病因和较大的基线LVEDV与MR改善独立相关，而基线LVEF则不然。与基线MR分级的强关联部分反映了终点对初始严重程度的固有依赖性。结论：在接受CRT并同时接受沙库巴曲/缬沙坦治疗的HFrEF患者中，随访时观察到较低的MR分级，并与LVEF、LVEDV和LAV的更大纵向变化相关。这些发现描述了在器械和药物治疗联合设置下MR严重程度和心脏结构的平行纵向变化。观察到的变化无法与正在进行的CRT介导的重构、伴随的GDMT、负荷条件的变化或其他时间依赖因素区分开来，也不能特异地归因于沙库巴曲/缬沙坦。

title: Contemporary Advances of Leadless Pacing and Conduction System Pacing in Children With Congenital Heart Disease
summary: The management of bradyarrhythmias requiring permanent pacing in pediatric patients and those with congenital heart disease (CHD) remains uniquely challenging due to continuous somatic growth, complex cardiac anatomy, limited vascular access, and long-term risks associated with conventional cardiac implantable electronic devices. Traditional transvenous endocardial and surgical epicardial pacing systems are associated with high rates of lead failure, venous occlusion, infection, and ventricular dyssynchrony. Leadless pacemakers and conduction system pacing have emerged as promising alternatives that overcome many of these historical limitations. This review provides a comprehensive, updated overview of the technical principles, clinical applications, advantages, limitations, and appropriate patient selection strategies for these two innovative modalities in the pediatric and CHD population. Critical clarifications are provided regarding venous access requirements, age-adjusted interpretation of QRS duration, ventricular dyssynchrony evaluation, and indications for device therapy according to pediatric-specific guidelines rather than adult-derived criteria. Clinical decision-making is integrated into a structured framework based on age, body size, clinical symptoms, ventricular synchrony, and arrhythmic risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 综述指出无导线起搏与传导系统起搏可克服儿童及先天性心脏病患者传统起搏的导线故障和静脉闭塞等局限，但需按年龄和体型个体化选择。
AI.motivation: 儿童及先天性心脏病（CHD）患者因持续生长、心脏解剖复杂、血管通路有限，传统经静脉心内膜和外科心外膜起搏系统导线故障、静脉闭塞、感染及心室不同步发生率高，需探索无导线起搏和传导系统起搏等替代方案。
AI.method: 综述性文章，系统总结无导线起搏和传导系统起搏的技术原理、临床应用、优势、局限及患者选择策略，并澄清静脉通路要求、年龄校正QRS时限解读、心室不同步评估及基于儿童指南而非成人标准的器械治疗适应证。

title: Idioventricular Rhythm: Electrophysiological Mechanisms, Clinical Recognition, and Contemporary Management Perspectives
summary: Idioventricular rhythm represents a slow, regular ventricular rhythm that emerges when higher-order cardiac pacemakers fail or are suppressed, permitting latent ventricular foci to assume the role of dominant pacemaker. Characterized by a rate typically below 50 beats per minute, absence of P waves, and a prolonged QRS interval, this rhythm exists along a continuum with accelerated idioventricular rhythm (AIVR), which occupies the intermediate rate range of 50 to 110 beats per minute. The electrophysiological basis of these rhythms involves abnormal calcium-dependent automatism affecting phase 4 diastolic depolarization, with triggered activity serving as the principal arrhythmogenic mechanism in digitalis toxicity. Etiological factors are diverse and include advanced or complete heart block, reperfusion following myocardial infarction, electrolyte disturbances, pharmacological agents, and, rarely, congenital heart disease or cardiomyopathies. Most patients remain asymptomatic, and the rhythm is typically identified during cardiac monitoring. Electrocardiography with clinical correlation remains the cornerstone of diagnosis. Management is predominantly conservative, focusing on the underlying causative etiology rather than suppression of the rhythm itself. The prognosis is generally favorable, with spontaneous resolution occurring when sinus frequency exceeds that of the ventricular focus. However, sustained or incessant forms associated with atrioventricular dissociation and syncope warrant therapeutic intervention. This review synthesizes current understanding of idioventricular rhythm and AIVR, emphasizing their electrophysiological foundations, clinical significance, and the importance of interprofessional care coordination in optimizing patient outcomes.

title: Effect of a structured nurse-led empowerment protocol on knowledge, practical skills, and self-care behaviours among patients with permanent pacemakers: a quasi-experimental study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Patients with permanent pacemakers frequently demonstrate insufficient knowledge and inadequate self-care behaviours, which increase the risk of avoidable post-implantation complications. Structured, theory-informed empowerment protocols may improve these outcomes, yet robust evidence from low- and middle-income countries remains limited. Grounded in Bandura's self-efficacy theory and a patient-empowerment model, this study evaluated the effect of a nurse-led empowerment protocol on knowledge, practical skills, and self-care behaviours among patients with permanent pacemakers.

METHODS: A non-equivalent control-group, pretest-posttest quasi-experimental design was used and reported in accordance with the Transparent Reporting of Evaluations with Nonrandomized Designs (TREND) statement. Seventy adults with newly implanted permanent pacemakers were recruited from Tanta University Hospitals, Egypt, between December 2025 and April 2026. Because the two arms were recruited in consecutive calendar periods to prevent educational contamination, allocation was non-random and group membership is confounded with time period. The control group (n = 35) received routine hospital care; the study group (n = 35) additionally received a structured empowerment protocol (four individual sessions of 30-45 min each, using illustrated Arabic booklets, demonstration and return demonstration, followed by weekly telephone reinforcement during the first month). Three co-primary outcomes were assessed at baseline, immediately post-intervention, and at one-month follow-up: knowledge (Pacemaker-Related Knowledge Questionnaire, 0-20), practice competence (Observational Checklist, 0-50), and self-care behaviour (Self-Care Behaviours Scale, 0-20). Data were analysed using repeated-measures ANOVA (group × time) with Greenhouse-Geisser correction and independent and paired t-tests; a family-wise threshold of α = 0.017 (0.05/3) was applied across the three co-primary group × time tests. Between-group effect sizes and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were computed.

RESULTS: The study group improved significantly more than the control group on all three co-primary outcomes. Mean knowledge scores rose from 6.51 ± 2.45 to 15.31 ± 3.46 post-intervention (control: 5.57 ± 2.47 to 7.46 ± 5.60; group × time F(1.43, 97.38) = 148.09, p < 0.001, η²p = 0.685; between-group post-intervention difference 7.85 points, 95% CI 5.67-10.03, Cohen's d = 1.69). Practice competence improved from 16.29 ± 2.87 to 41.17 ± 10.00 in the study group (control: 14.91 ± 3.33 to 18.54 ± 12.21; F(1.59, 108.12) = 120.34, p < 0.001, η²p = 0.639; difference 22.63, 95% CI 17.40-27.86, d = 2.03). Self-care behaviour scores increased from 13.63 ± 3.11 to 19.00 ± 3.23 in the study group (control: 12.86 ± 2.30 to 15.00 ± 3.10; F(2, 136) = 49.85, p < 0.001, η²p = 0.423; difference 4.00, 95% CI 2.52-5.48, d = 1.26). All three interactions remained significant at the family-wise threshold, and the groups did not differ significantly on any recorded baseline characteristic. Gains were partially sustained at one-month follow-up.

CONCLUSIONS: In this non-randomised study, participants who received a structured, nurse-led empowerment protocol showed substantial and partially sustained gains in knowledge, practical skills, and self-care behaviours, whereas the corresponding gains observed under routine hospital care alone were minimal. Because the two groups were recruited in consecutive calendar periods rather than randomised concurrently, and because outcome assessment was unblinded, these results are best interpreted as an association observed under a quasi-experimental design rather than as causal evidence equivalent to that of a randomised controlled trial. They nonetheless provide a reasonable basis for evaluating systematic, interactive empowerment programmes-incorporating individualised education and scheduled reinforcement-as an addition to routine post-implantation nursing care, and for testing them in randomised, attention-controlled trials with blinded assessment and longer follow-up.

TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT07743346. Registered on 26 July 2026. Retrospectively registered. Available at: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07743346 .

AI.tldr: 在埃及新植入永久起搏器的成人中，护士主导的结构化赋能方案较常规护理显著改善知识、操作技能和自我护理行为，效应量大且部分维持至1个月，但非随机设计限制因果推断。
AI.motivation: 永久起搏器患者常存在知识不足和自我护理行为欠佳，增加可避免的植入后并发症风险。基于自我效能理论和患者赋能模型的结构化方案可能改善这些结局，但来自中低收入国家的稳健证据有限。
AI.method: 非等效对照组、前后测准实验设计，遵循TREND声明。2025年12月至2026年4月在埃及Tanta大学医院招募70例新植入永久起搏器的成人，因按连续日历周期招募以避免教育污染，分组非随机且与时间期混杂。对照组（n=35）接受常规医院护理；研究组（n=35）额外接受结构化赋能方案（4次个体化课程，每次30-45分钟，使用图文阿拉伯语手册、示范与回示教，并在第一个月内每周电话强化）。三个共同主要终点在基线、干预后即刻和1个月随访时评估：知识（起搏器相关知识问卷，0-20分）、操作能力（观察清单，0-50分）和自我护理行为（自我护理行为量表，0-20分）。采用重复测量方差分析（组×时间）及Greenhouse-Geisser校正，并进行独立和配对t检验；三个共同主要组×时间检验采用族错误率阈值α=0.017（0.05/3）。计算组间效应量和95%置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 在这项非随机研究中，接受结构化护士主导赋能方案的患者在知识、操作技能和自我护理行为方面获得大幅且部分持续的改善，而单纯常规医院护理下相应改善甚微。由于两组按连续日历周期招募而非同时随机化，且结局评估未设盲，结果应解释为准实验设计下观察到的关联，而非等同于随机对照试验的因果证据。尽管如此，这些结果为将系统性、互动式赋能方案（包括个体化教育和定期强化）作为常规植入后护理的补充提供了合理依据，并支持在随机、注意力对照、盲法评估和更长随访的试验中进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：永久性心脏起搏器患者常表现出知识不足和自我护理行为欠缺，这增加了可避免的植入后并发症风险。结构化的、基于理论的赋能方案可能改善这些结局，但来自中低收入国家的有力证据仍然有限。本研究以Bandura的自我效能理论和患者赋能模型为基础，评估了护士主导的赋能方案对永久性心脏起搏器患者知识、实践技能和自我护理行为的影响。

方法：采用非等效对照组、前测-后测准实验设计，并按照非随机设计评价报告透明化（TREND）声明进行报告。2025年12月至2026年4月期间，从埃及坦塔大学医院招募了70名新植入永久性心脏起搏器的成年人。由于两个组按连续日历时间段招募以防止教育污染，分配为非随机，且组别与时间段存在混杂。对照组（n = 35）接受常规医院护理；研究组（n = 35）额外接受结构化赋能方案（四次个别会话，每次30-45分钟，使用图文并茂的阿拉伯语手册、示范和回示范，随后在第一个月内每周进行电话强化）。在基线、干预后即刻和一个月随访时评估三个共同主要结局：知识（起搏器相关知识问卷，0-20分）、实践能力（观察性检查表，0-50分）和自我护理行为（自我护理行为量表，0-20分）。数据采用重复测量方差分析（组别×时间）并应用Greenhouse-Geisser校正，以及独立样本和配对t检验进行分析；对三个共同主要组别×时间检验应用族系错误率阈值α = 0.017（0.05/3）。计算了组间效应量和95%置信区间（CIs）。

结果：研究组在所有三个共同主要结局上的改善均显著大于对照组。平均知识得分从6.51 ± 2.45升至干预后的15.31 ± 3.46（对照组：5.57 ± 2.47至7.46 ± 5.60；组别×时间F(1.43, 97.38) = 148.09，p < 0.001，η²p = 0.685；干预后组间差异7.85分，95% CI 5.67-10.03，Cohen's d = 1.69）。研究组实践能力从16.29 ± 2.87改善至41.17 ± 10.00（对照组：14.91 ± 3.33至18.54 ± 12.21；F(1.59, 108.12) = 120.34，p < 0.001，η²p = 0.639；差异22.63，95% CI 17.40-27.86，d = 2.03）。研究组自我护理行为得分从13.63 ± 3.11增至19.00 ± 3.23（对照组：12.86 ± 2.30至15.00 ± 3.10；F(2, 136) = 49.85，p < 0.001，η²p = 0.423；差异4.00，95% CI 2.52-5.48，d = 1.26）。所有三个交互作用在族系错误率阈值下均保持显著，且两组在任何记录的基线特征上均无显著差异。在一个月随访时，改善部分得以维持。

结论：在这项非随机研究中，接受结构化、护士主导的赋能方案的参与者在知识、实践技能和自我护理行为方面表现出大幅且部分持续的改善，而仅接受常规医院护理的相应改善甚微。由于两组按连续日历时间段招募而非同时随机化，且结局评估为非盲法，这些结果最好解释为准实验设计下观察到的关联，而非等同于随机对照试验的因果证据。尽管如此，它们为评估系统化、互动式赋能方案——纳入个体化教育和计划性强化——作为常规植入后护理的补充提供了合理依据，并为进一步在采用盲法评估和更长随访的随机、注意力控制试验中进行检验提供了基础。

title: The C-reactive protein-albumin-lymphocyte index is associated with ventricular functional improvement and long-term outcomes after cardiac resynchronization therapy.
summary:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Inflammation, malnutrition, and immune dysfunction are closely linked to adverse outcomes in heart failure. The C-reactive protein-albumin-lymphocyte (CALLY) index integrates these biological domains, but its clinical relevance in patients undergoing cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) remains insufficiently characterized. We investigated whether CALLY is associated with left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) improvement and long-term clinical outcomes after CRT.

METHODS: In this multicenter retrospective cohort study, 213 consecutive patients who underwent CRT implantation between January 2015 and August 2025 were enrolled. The CALLY index was analyzed primarily as a log2-transformed continuous variable. The primary endpoint was time to first major adverse cardiovascular event (MACE), defined as all-cause mortality, heart transplantation, left ventricular assist device implantation, or heart-failure rehospitalization. Echocardiographic response was evaluated in 191 patients with follow-up imaging. Multivariable Cox and linear regression were used to assess associations with MACE and absolute change in LVEF, respectively. Sensitivity analyses addressed baseline LVEF, pacemaker upgrade status, calendar era, and alternative handling of CRp values at the lower detection limit.

RESULTS: During a median follow-up of 18 months, 56 patients (26.3%) experienced MACE, including 48 heart-failure rehospitalizations and 8 deaths. Each doubling of baseline CALLY was associated with a lower hazard of MACE (hazard ratio, 0.751; 95% confidence interval, 0.664-0.850; p < 0.001) and greater LVEF improvement (β = 0.949 percentage points; 95% confidence interval, 0.313-1.586; p = 0.004). Addition of CALLY to a parsimonious clinical model increased the Harrell C-index from 0.672 to 0.738; the optimism-corrected C-index was 0.705. Time-dependent AUCs were 0.773 and 0.759 at 12 and 18 months, respectively. The findings remained consistent after restriction to patients with LVEF ≤35%, exclusion of pacemaker-upgrade patients, adjustment or stratification by calendar era, and alternative approaches to CRp values at the lower detection limit, with no significant interactions by baseline LVEF or calendar era.

CONCLUSION: A higher baseline CALLY index was independently associated with greater LVEF improvement and a lower hazard of adverse cardiovascular outcomes after CRT. CALLY may provide complementary prognostic information in patients undergoing CRT, although prospective external validation is required before clinical implementation.

AI.tldr: 基线CALLY指数每翻倍，CRT术后MACE风险降低25%，LVEF改善增加0.95个百分点，提示其可作为预后评估的补充指标。
AI.motivation: 炎症、营养不良和免疫功能障碍与心衰不良预后密切相关，CALLY指数整合了这三个维度，但其在心脏再同步治疗（CRT）患者中的临床价值尚不明确。本研究旨在探讨CALLY指数与CRT术后左室射血分数（LVEF）改善及长期临床结局的关联。
AI.method: 多中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2015年1月至2025年8月连续213例接受CRT植入的患者。CALLY指数以log2转换的连续变量分析。主要终点为首次主要不良心血管事件（MACE），定义为全因死亡、心脏移植、左室辅助装置植入或心衰再住院。191例有随访影像的患者评估超声心动图反应。采用多变量Cox回归和线性回归分别评估与MACE和LVEF绝对变化的关系，并进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 中位随访18个月，56例（26.3%）发生MACE（48例心衰再住院，8例死亡）。基线CALLY每翻倍，MACE风险降低（HR 0.751，95%CI 0.664-0.850，P<0.001），LVEF改善增加（β=0.949个百分点，95%CI 0.313-1.586，P=0.004）。将CALLY加入简约临床模型后，Harrell C指数从0.672升至0.738（乐观校正后0.705），12和18个月时间依赖AUC分别为0.773和0.759。敏感性分析结果一致，基线LVEF和日历年代无显著交互作用。
AI.conclusion: 较高的基线CALLY指数独立关联于CRT术后更大的LVEF改善和更低的不良心血管事件风险，可能为CRT患者提供补充预后信息。但需前瞻性外部验证后方可用于临床实践。

summary_zh:
背景与目的：炎症、营养不良和免疫功能障碍与心力衰竭的不良结局密切相关。C反应蛋白-白蛋白-淋巴细胞（CALLY）指数整合了这些生物学领域，但其在接受心脏再同步治疗（CRT）患者中的临床相关性仍未被充分描述。我们研究了CALLY是否与CRT后左心室射血分数（LVEF）改善及长期临床结局相关。

方法：在这项多中心回顾性队列研究中，纳入了2015年1月至2025年8月期间连续接受CRT植入的213例患者。CALLY指数主要作为log2转换的连续变量进行分析。主要终点是首次主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的时间，定义为全因死亡、心脏移植、左心室辅助装置植入或心力衰竭再住院。对191例有随访影像的患者评估了超声心动图反应。分别使用多变量Cox回归和线性回归评估与MACE和LVEF绝对变化的关联。敏感性分析涉及基线LVEF、起搏器升级状态、日历年代以及CRP值在检测下限的替代处理方式。

结果：在中位随访18个月期间，56例患者（26.3%）发生MACE，包括48例心力衰竭再住院和8例死亡。基线CALLY每翻倍与较低的MACE风险相关（风险比，0.751；95%置信区间，0.664-0.850；p < 0.001），并与更大的LVEF改善相关（β = 0.949个百分点；95%置信区间，0.313-1.586；p = 0.004）。将CALLY加入一个简约临床模型后，Harrell C指数从0.672增加到0.738；乐观校正后的C指数为0.705。12个月和18个月的时间依赖性AUC分别为0.773和0.759。在限制于LVEF ≤35%的患者、排除起搏器升级患者、按日历年代调整或分层，以及对CRP值在检测下限的替代处理方法后，研究结果保持一致，且按基线LVEF或日历年代未见显著交互作用。

结论：较高的基线CALLY指数独立地与CRT后更大的LVEF改善和较低的不良心血管结局风险相关。CALLY可能为接受CRT的患者提供补充性预后信息，但在临床实施前需要进行前瞻性外部验证。

title: Algorithm-Facilitated Pacemaker-Mediated Tachycardia Mimicking Refractory Septic Shock.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Algorithms that minimize right ventricular pacing, such as atrioventricular (AV) hysteresis, prolong the AV delay to promote intrinsic conduction. With intact ventriculoatrial (VA) conduction, this can facilitate pacemaker-mediated tachycardia (PMT).

CASE SUMMARY: A 62-year-old woman with a dual-chamber pacemaker presented with respiratory failure and hypotension at a paced rate of 110 beats/min, treated for presumed sepsis with escalating vasopressors. Interrogation showed an upper tracking rate of 130 beats/min, AV hysteresis ON, and postventricular atrial refractory period (PVARP) (225 milliseconds) shorter than VA conduction (360 milliseconds), producing a 550-millisecond endless-loop PMT (∼109 beats/min) that escaped device detection. Disabling hysteresis and extending PVARP terminated it, allowing vasopressor weaning.

DISCUSSION: When PVARP is shorter than the VA interval, a long AV delay converts retrograde conduction into a slow re-entrant circuit that escapes device diagnostics and mimics sinus tachycardia.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: Suspect slow PMT in paced patients with fixed tachycardia near 100-110 beats/min when AV hysteresis is active. Disabling hysteresis and extending PVARP beyond VA conduction is diagnostic and lifesaving.

AI.tldr: 62岁双腔起搏器患者因AV滞后算法与PVARP短于VA传导间期，引发约109次/分的慢速起搏器介导性心动过速，被误诊为脓毒性休克，调整起搏参数后终止。
AI.motivation: 起搏器最小化右室起搏的算法（如AV滞后）可延长AV延迟以促进自身传导，但在VA传导完整的患者中可能促进起搏器介导性心动过速（PMT）。既往对慢速PMT认识不足，易被误诊为窦性心动过速或脓毒性休克，导致不当治疗。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为62岁女性，双腔起搏器植入者，因呼吸衰竭和低血压就诊，起搏频率110次/分，按脓毒性休克予升压药治疗。通过起搏器程控检查明确诊断，并调整参数（关闭AV滞后、延长PVARP）进行干预。
AI.result: 程控显示上限跟踪频率130次/分，AV滞后开启，PVARP为225毫秒，短于VA传导时间360毫秒，形成550毫秒的无限循环PMT（约109次/分），未被设备诊断识别。关闭滞后并延长PVARP后心动过速终止，升压药顺利撤停。
AI.conclusion: 对于起搏频率固定在100-110次/分且AV滞后开启的患者，应警惕慢速PMT。关闭AV滞后并将PVARP延长至超过VA传导时间既是诊断手段也是救命措施。临床需注意起搏器算法相关的心动过速可模拟脓毒性休克，及时程控检查至关重要。

summary_zh:
背景：最小化右心室起搏的算法，如房室（AV）滞后，通过延长AV延迟来促进自身传导。在室房（VA）传导完整的情况下，这可能促进起搏器介导性心动过速（PMT）。

病例摘要：一名62岁女性，植入双腔起搏器，因呼吸衰竭和低血压就诊，起搏频率为110次/分，按推测的脓毒症治疗并逐步升级血管升压药。程控检查显示上限跟踪频率为130次/分，AV滞后开启，且心室后心房不应期（PVARP）（225毫秒）短于VA传导时间（360毫秒），产生550毫秒的无休止环路PMT（约109次/分），未被设备检测到。关闭滞后并延长PVARP后终止了心动过速，得以逐渐停用血管升压药。

讨论：当PVARP短于VA间期时，长AV延迟将逆行传导转化为缓慢的折返环路，从而逃逸设备诊断并模仿窦性心动过速。

要点：对于起搏频率固定在100-110次/分附近且AV滞后开启的起搏患者，应怀疑缓慢型PMT。关闭滞后并将PVARP延长至超过VA传导时间具有诊断意义并可挽救生命。

title: Alcoholic Cardiomyopathy Mortality in the United States (1999-2024): Trends, Disparities, and Opportunities for Prevention
summary: Aim: This study aimed to characterize long-term US mortality from alcoholic cardiomyopathy (ACM), compare its trajectory with other major cardiomyopathy subtypes, and identify demographic and geographic disparities relevant to cardiovascular prevention.Methods: We conducted a serial cross-sectional analysis of Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Wide-ranging Online Data for Epidemiologic Research (CDC WONDER) underlying-cause-of-death data from 1999 to 2024.Cardiomyopathy deaths were identified using ICD-10 codes I42.0, I42.1, I42.2, I42.5, I42.6, I42.8, and I42.9.Annual age-adjusted mortality rates (AAMRs) were assessed overall and by sex; agespecific crude death rates (CDRs) were recalculated for ages 15-44, 45-64, and 65-84 years.ACM mortality was also examined by race and state.Results: From 1999 to 2024, AAMRs declined for dilated cardiomyopathy (1.965 to 0.716 per 100,000; -63.6%), unspecified cardiomyopathy (7.196 to 3.155; -56.2%), and other hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (0.450 to 0.228; -49.2%).ACM declined less, from 0.199 to 0.144 (-27.7%), with an increase during the early 2020s.Male ACM AAMR declined from 0.408 to 0.209 but remained nearly fourfold the female rate in 2024 (0.054).Mortality was concentrated among middle-aged and older males; American Indian or Alaska Native individuals had the highest population-based ACM mortality, and Alaska had the highest pooled state AAMR in 2018-2024.Conclusion: ACM showed a smaller long-term mortality reduction than several major cardiomyopathy subtypes and persistent demographic and geographic disparities.Integrating cardiovascular prevention and heart failure care with recognition and treatment of harmful alcohol use may help reduce this potentially modifiable burden.

AI.tldr: 1999-2024年美国酒精性心肌病年龄标化死亡率仅下降27.7%，降幅小于其他主要心肌病亚型，且男性、美国印第安/阿拉斯加原住民及阿拉斯加州负担最高。
AI.motivation: 酒精性心肌病（ACM）是潜在可预防的心力衰竭病因，但缺乏长期全国性死亡趋势及其与其他心肌病亚型的对比，也缺乏人群与地理差异数据，难以指导心血管预防资源配置。
AI.method: 基于CDC WONDER 1999-2024年根本死因数据的系列横断面分析。以ICD-10代码I42.0、I42.1、I42.2、I42.5、I42.6、I42.8、I42.9识别心肌病死亡。计算总体及分性别的年龄标化死亡率（AAMR），并按15-44、45-64、65-84岁重算年龄别粗死亡率（CDR），同时分析ACM死亡率的种族和州际差异。
AI.result: 1999-2024年，扩张型心肌病AAMR从1.965降至0.716/10万（-63.6%），未特指心肌病从7.196降至3.155（-56.2%），其他肥厚型心肌病从0.450降至0.228（-49.2%）；ACM仅从0.199降至0.144（-27.7%），且在2020年代初出现上升。男性ACM AAMR从0.408降至0.209，但2024年仍约为女性（0.054）的近4倍。死亡集中于中老年男性；美国印第安/阿拉斯加原住民人群ACM死亡率最高，阿拉斯加州2018-2024年合并AAMR最高。
AI.conclusion: ACM长期死亡率降幅小于其他主要心肌病亚型，且存在持续的人群与地理差异。将心血管预防和心衰管理同有害酒精使用的识别与治疗相结合，可能有助于减轻这一潜在可修饰的疾病负担。本研究为生态学分析，无法推断个体因果，且依赖死亡证明编码准确性。

summary_zh:
目的：本研究旨在描述美国酒精性心肌病（ACM）的长期死亡率特征，将其轨迹与其他主要心肌病亚型进行比较，并识别与心血管预防相关的人口学和地理差异。

方法：我们对1999年至2024年疾病控制与预防中心流行病学研究广泛在线数据（CDC WONDER）的根本死因数据进行了系列横断面分析。心肌病死亡使用ICD-10编码I42.0、I42.1、I42.2、I42.5、I42.6、I42.8和I42.9进行识别。评估了总体和按性别的年年龄调整死亡率（AAMR）；重新计算了15-44岁、45-64岁和65-84岁的年龄别粗死亡率（CDR）。还按种族和州检查了ACM死亡率。

结果：从1999年到2024年，扩张型心肌病（每10万人1.965至0.716；-63.6%）、未特指心肌病（7.196至3.155；-56.2%）和其他肥厚型心肌病（0.450至0.228；-49.2%）的AAMR下降。ACM下降较少，从0.199降至0.144（-27.7%），并在2020年代初出现上升。男性ACM AAMR从0.408降至0.209，但2024年仍接近女性的四倍（0.054）。死亡率集中在中老年男性；美洲印第安人或阿拉斯加原住民个体的基于人群的ACM死亡率最高，阿拉斯加在2018-2024年的汇总州AAMR最高。

结论：与几个主要心肌病亚型相比，ACM的长期死亡率降低幅度较小，且人口学和地理差异持续存在。将心血管预防和心力衰竭护理与识别和治疗有害酒精使用相结合，可能有助于减轻这一潜在可改变的负担。

title: Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia with diagnostic difficulty differentiating seizures from syncope: a case report.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT) is a potentially fatal inherited arrhythmia syndrome triggered by exercise or emotional stress that may mimic epileptic seizures, resulting in delayed diagnosis.

CASE PRESENTATION: We report the case of a 6-year-old girl with recurrent transient loss of consciousness (T-LOC) who was initially misdiagnosed with epilepsy. She experienced three episodes of T-LOC between 4 and 6 years of age. The first two episodes occurred during or immediately post-exercise, whereas the third appeared non-exertional; however, retrospective review suggested fear-induced sympathetic activation as the trigger. During the second and third episodes, she exhibited eye opening, fixed gaze, and tonic posturing, closely resembling epileptic seizures. Interictal electroencephalography was normal, resting electrocardiography (ECG) showed sinus bradycardia without QT prolongation, and an initial Master's triple two-step exercise test increased the heart rate to only 74 beats per minute (bpm) without inducing arrhythmia. She was provisionally diagnosed with epilepsy, and a diagnostic trial of levetiracetam was initiated. Four months later, school-based ECG screening, prompted by her history of seizure-like episodes with impaired consciousness, led to further cardiac evaluation, which revealed bigeminal premature ventricular contractions. Subsequent treadmill exercise testing at a tertiary center induced bidirectional ventricular tachycardia at a heart rate of 144 bpm, confirming the diagnosis of CPVT. Genetic testing identified a pathogenic ryanodine receptor 2 (RYR2) variant (c.11836G > A, p.Gly3946Ser). Treatment with nadolol and flecainide was initiated, levetiracetam was discontinued, and she has remained free of syncope and seizure-like episodes for >2 years.

CONCLUSION: This case highlights the diagnostic challenges of CPVT, and underscores the need for specialized evaluation, including repeat exercise testing under varying conditions, in children with exercise- or emotion-induced T-LOC suggestive of cardiac syncope.

AI.tldr: 6岁女孩因运动或情绪诱发的短暂意识丧失被误诊为癫痫，最终通过运动试验诱发双向室速及RYR2基因突变确诊CPVT，提示儿童癫痫样发作需警惕遗传性心律失常。
AI.motivation: CPVT是一种由运动或情绪应激诱发的遗传性心律失常综合征，可表现为癫痫样发作，常被误诊为癫痫而延误诊断。既往证据多来自成人或小样本研究，儿童病例的诊断挑战尚未充分描述。
AI.method: 病例报告。研究对象为1例6岁女孩，自4岁起反复出现短暂意识丧失（T-LOC）共3次，其中2次与运动相关，1次疑为恐惧诱发。初始脑电图正常，静息心电图示窦性心动过缓、QT间期正常，Master三阶梯运动试验心率仅升至74 bpm且未诱发心律失常，初步诊断为癫痫并给予左乙拉西坦试验性治疗。后经学校心电图筛查发现室性早搏二联律，转至三级中心行平板运动试验，并完成基因检测。
AI.result: 平板运动试验在心率144 bpm时诱发了双向性室性心动过速，确诊CPVT。基因检测发现致病性RYR2变异（c.11836G>A，p.Gly3946Ser）。治疗改为纳多洛尔联合氟卡尼，停用左乙拉西坦，随访>2年无晕厥及癫痫样发作。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示CPVT在儿童中诊断困难，对于运动或情绪诱发的T-LOC，即使初始运动试验阴性，也应考虑重复运动试验及基因检测以明确诊断。早期识别并启动β受体阻滞剂联合氟卡尼治疗可有效预防心律失常事件。局限性为单病例报告，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
引言：儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速（CPVT）是一种可能致命的遗传性心律失常综合征，由运动或情绪应激诱发，可能模仿癫痫发作，导致诊断延迟。

病例介绍：我们报告一例6岁女孩，反复发生短暂性意识丧失（T-LOC），最初被误诊为癫痫。她在4至6岁期间经历了三次T-LOC发作。前两次发作发生在运动期间或运动后即刻，而第三次为非运动性；然而，回顾性分析提示恐惧诱导的交感神经激活为诱因。在第二次和第三次发作期间，她表现为睁眼、凝视和强直姿势，与癫痫发作极为相似。发作间期脑电图正常，静息心电图（ECG）显示窦性心动过缓，无QT延长，初始的Master三阶梯二步运动试验仅使心率增至74次/分（bpm），未诱发心律失常。她被初步诊断为癫痫，并开始左乙拉西坦诊断性治疗。四个月后，基于其意识受损的癫痫样发作病史，学校心电图筛查促使进一步心脏评估，发现二联律性室性早搏。随后在三级中心进行的平板运动试验以144次/分的心率诱发了双向性室性心动过速，证实了CPVT的诊断。基因检测发现致病性兰尼碱受体2（RYR2）变异（c.11836G > A，p.Gly3946Ser）。开始纳多洛尔和氟卡尼治疗，停用左乙拉西坦，她已无晕厥和癫痫样发作超过2年。

结论：本病例凸显了CPVT的诊断挑战，并强调对于运动或情绪诱发的T-LOC提示心源性晕厥的儿童，需要进行专门评估，包括在不同条件下重复运动试验。

title: Metabolomic biomarkers and metabolic remodelling in genetically characterised hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: a systematic review.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) is the most common inherited cardiomyopathy and a major cause of heart failure, malignant arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death. Although pathogenic variants in sarcomeric genes such as MYBPC3, MYH7, TNNT2, and TNNI3 are well-recognised contributors to the disease, the mechanisms linking these mutations to the heterogeneous phenotypes remain poorly understood. Increasing evidence suggests that HCM is fundamentally associated with disturbances in myocardial energetics and metabolic remodelling.

OBJECTIVES: This systematic review aimed to synthesise metabolomic evidence from genetically characterised HCM cohorts, with three specific objectives: (1) to characterise the metabolic pathways dysregulated in HCM, (2) to determine whether distinct metabolic signatures are associated with specific sarcomeric gene variants and (3) to evaluate the diagnostic, prognostic, and therapeutic relevance of identified metabolite biomarkers in HCM management. By explicitly examining whether genotype-specific metabolomic signatures exist in the current literature, this review addresses a question of direct relevance to precision medicine approaches in HCM.

METHODS: A systematic search of PubMed, Scopus and Web of Science identified 14 eligible studies comprising 1511 participants.

RESULTS: Most studies employed liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LCMS) based metabolomics using plasma or myocardial tissue samples. Across studies, recurrent metabolic alterations were observed in pathways related to fatty acid oxidation, branched-chain amino acid (BCAA) metabolism, ketone body utilisation, tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle intermediates and lipid metabolism. Circulating acyl carnitines, amino acids, and eicosanoid metabolites were among the most frequently reported biomarkers associated with disease presence or severity. Myocardial tissue analyses demonstrated impaired mitochondrial energetics, reductions in high-energy phosphate metabolites, and shifts toward alternative metabolic substrates.

CONCLUSION: No distinct genotype-specific metabolic signature was identified across studies; the metabolic remodelling pattern reflected phenotypic severity rather than the causal variants. While metabolomics shows potential in improving disease characterisation and biomarker discovery, further longitudinal and externally validated studies are required before clinical translation.

AI.tldr: 系统综述14项研究共1511例基因特征明确的肥厚型心肌病患者，未发现基因型特异性代谢特征，代谢重塑与表型严重程度相关而非致病基因变异。
AI.motivation: 肥厚型心肌病（HCM）是最常见的遗传性心肌病，是心力衰竭、恶性心律失常和心源性猝死的重要原因。尽管肌节基因（如MYBPC3、MYH7、TNNT2、TNNI3）致病变异已被广泛认识，但其与异质性表型之间的机制尚不清楚。越来越多证据提示HCM与心肌能量代谢紊乱和代谢重塑相关，但基因型与代谢特征之间的关系尚未系统评价。
AI.method: 系统综述，检索PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science数据库，纳入14项符合条件的研究，共1511例参与者。主要目标为：（1）描述HCM中失调的代谢通路；（2）确定是否存在与特定肌节基因变异相关的代谢特征；（3）评价代谢物生物标志物在HCM管理中的诊断、预后和治疗价值。
AI.result: 多数研究采用基于液相色谱-质谱（LC-MS）的代谢组学方法，样本为血浆或心肌组织。研究反复观察到脂肪酸氧化、支链氨基酸（BCAA）代谢、酮体利用、三羧酸（TCA）循环中间产物和脂质代谢相关通路异常。循环酰基肉碱、氨基酸和类花生酸代谢物是与疾病存在或严重程度相关的最常见生物标志物。心肌组织分析显示线粒体能量代谢受损、高能磷酸代谢物减少以及向替代代谢底物转移。未发现基因型特异性代谢特征；代谢重塑模式反映表型严重程度而非致病基因变异。
AI.conclusion: 本系统综述未发现基因型特异性代谢特征，HCM代谢重塑与表型严重程度相关而非致病基因变异。代谢组学在改善疾病表征和发现生物标志物方面具有潜力，但在临床转化前仍需进一步开展纵向研究和外部验证研究。

summary_zh:
引言：肥厚型心肌病（HCM）是最常见的遗传性心肌病，也是心力衰竭、恶性心律失常和心源性猝死的主要原因。尽管肌节基因如MYBPC3、MYH7、TNNT2和TNNI3中的致病性变异已被公认是该病的促成因素，但将这些突变与异质性表型联系起来的机制仍知之甚少。越来越多的证据表明，HCM从根本上与心肌能量代谢紊乱和代谢重构相关。

目的：本系统综述旨在综合来自基因特征明确的HCM队列的代谢组学证据，具体目标有三：（1）描述HCM中失调的代谢途径；（2）确定是否存在与特定肌节基因变异相关的独特代谢特征；（3）评估已识别的代谢物生物标志物在HCM管理中的诊断、预后和治疗相关性。通过明确检查当前文献中是否存在基因型特异性的代谢组学特征，本综述解决了一个与HCM精准医学方法直接相关的问题。

方法：对PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science进行系统检索，确定了14项符合条件的研究，共包含1511名参与者。

结果：大多数研究采用基于液相色谱-质谱联用（LCMS）的代谢组学方法，使用血浆或心肌组织样本。在各研究中，反复观察到与脂肪酸氧化、支链氨基酸（BCAA）代谢、酮体利用、三羧酸（TCA）循环中间产物和脂质代谢相关的途径发生代谢改变。循环酰基肉碱、氨基酸和类花生酸代谢物是与疾病存在或严重程度相关的最常报告的生物标志物之一。心肌组织分析显示线粒体能量代谢受损、高能磷酸盐代谢物减少以及向替代代谢底物的转变。

结论：在各研究中未发现独特的基因型特异性代谢特征；代谢重构模式反映的是表型严重程度而非因果变异。尽管代谢组学在改善疾病特征描述和生物标志物发现方面显示出潜力，但在临床转化之前仍需进一步的纵向和外部验证研究。

title: AI-ECG potassium to triage haemolysed hyperkalaemia: analysis code
summary: Analysis code for an electrocardiogram-based deep learning potassium estimate to distinguish haemolytic pseudohyperkalaemia from true hyperkalaemia (development on HEEDB, external validation on MIMIC-IV). Code only: no patient data, record-level derivatives or model weights are included.
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

AI.tldr: 该研究提供基于心电图深度学习估计血钾的分析代码，用于区分溶血性假性高钾血症与真性高钾血症，模型在HEEDB开发并在MIMIC-IV外部验证。
AI.motivation: 溶血标本常导致假性高钾血症，与真性高钾血症难以区分，可能造成不必要的紧急降钾治疗；既往缺乏无创、快速甄别手段，本研究探索AI-ECG血钾估计能否辅助分诊。
AI.method: 研究为分析代码发布，不含患者数据、记录级衍生数据或模型权重。模型开发队列为HEEDB，外部验证队列为MIMIC-IV；干预/暴露为基于心电图的深度学习血钾估计，主要终点为区分溶血性假性高钾血症与真性高钾血症。摘要未报告样本量、终点定义细节及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何效应量、95%置信区间或P值等关键统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为AI-ECG血钾估计用于高钾血症分诊提供可复现的分析代码，有望减少溶血标本导致的误判；但摘要未报告性能数据，且代码不含数据与模型权重，临床价值尚待完整结果验证。
